definitions.explanation: The highest level of professional baseball in North America, consisting of the American League and National League.

examples.japanese: MLBで{活躍|かつやく}する{日本人|にほんじん}{選手|せんしゅ}。
examples.english: Japanese players who are active in MLB.

examples.japanese: MLBの{開幕戦|かいまくせん}を{楽|たの}しみにしている。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the MLB opening game.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{来年|らいねん}MLBに{挑戦|ちょうせん}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: He plans to challenge himself in MLB next year.

notes:
MLB stands for 'Major League Baseball.' It is often called {大|だい}リーグ or メジャーリーグ in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- MLB{選手|せんしゅ}: MLB player
- MLB{移籍|いせき}: transfer to MLB
- MLB{挑戦|ちょうせん}: attempt to play in MLB
- MLBオールスター: MLB All-Star Game

JAPANESE TERMINOLOGY:
- {大|だい}リーグ/メジャーリーグ: Major League
- メジャーリーガー: Major Leaguer
- {日本|にほん}プロ{野球|やきゅう} (NPB): Nippon Professional Baseball

NOTABLE JAPANESE MLB PLAYERS:
Many Japanese players have had successful MLB careers, including {大谷|おおたに}{翔平|しょうへい} (Shohei Ohtani), {鈴木|すずき}イチロー (Ichiro Suzuki), and {野茂|のも}{英雄|ひでお} (Hideo Nomo).
